unresolved: Signer custody and organizational independence are not observable on-chain. The Safe threshold, owners, per-owner code, and transaction counts were measured; no custody claim is made.

The live-market mutation simulation used msETH/WETH clone 0x7b1b38ca…e73b6 and its verified shared MarketCore implementation. All 17 MarketCreator event-derived markets were not individually re-simulated, so an idiosyncratic deployed market override is not excluded.

No deployment search was performed outside Ethereum. Tangent's live protocol and the supplied asset scope identify Ethereum; a differently addressed deployment on another chain is not excluded by this walk.
walk_notes: ✅ HAND-WALKED 2026-09-06, NOT GENERATOR OUTPUT. Ethereum state was read at
block 25915396 through ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com. Every address supplied in
the handoff was treated as a candidate and re-read before inclusion.
⚠️ THREE DISTINCT POWERS TERMINATE AT THE SAME 3-OF-5 SAFE WITH NO EXECUTION
DELAY: token/supply administration, live-market risk parameters, and PegKeeper
control. getThreshold()=3, getOwners() returned five addresses, nonce()=97,
and getModulesPaginated(0x1,10) returned no enabled modules.
⚠️ THE LIVE-MARKET ORACLE PATH IS IMMEDIATE AND FULL-BOOK. On the live
msETH/WETH clone 0x7b1b38ca…e73b6, eth_call from the Safe succeeded for
setMaxLTV(71000), setLiquidationThreshold(77000), and
setCollatOracle(0x…dEaD); the same calls from 0x…dEaD reverted OnlyOwner.
The clone points immutably to verified StakeDaoVaultV2Market implementation
0xbce94d13…a514e4, whose shared MarketCore defines these setters. Thus the
Safe can repoint collatOracle on a live market in one undelayed transaction;
that oracle feeds virtual_price x MIN(coin price), moving every position's
health at once.
⚠️ `timelock: none` IS MEASURED, NOT INHERITED FROM PROSE. The USG token,
MarketCreator, regulator, and live market expose direct Safe admin/owner paths;
holder simulations succeeded and stranger controls reverted. The PegKeepers'
three-day ADMIN_ACTIONS_DELAY applies only to replacing their admin. It does
not delay set_new_regulator, set_new_action_delay, or the regulator's risk
setters, all directly callable by the current Safe. cap() and maxSupply()
both revert and are recorded only as cap-getter measurements, never as delay
evidence.
⚠️ THE TRUNCATED REGULATOR WAS NOT RECONSTRUCTED. regulator() on both
PegKeepers independently returned 0x887706612730B7A227f3bFFD8c9A6E6c3Cb3F19E;
its admin() returns the Safe and stablecoin() returns USG.

The added nonce-0 signer still has zero transaction history. One owner now has

⚠️ DEPLOYER DISTINCTION. Creation transactions show the USG token and
MarketCreator were deployed by 0xe08c2512…c2f6, which is not a current Safe
owner. 0x505fb456…ae45 created the Safe through SafeProxyFactory and remains an
owner. The older prose collapsed "contract deployer" and "Safe creator" into
one signer claim; paths below retain both facts explicitly.
